item.title: 2 charged with attempting to support ISIS in Gracie Mansion bomb plot
item.description: Two Bucks County men accused of bringing explosives to a protest outside Gracie Mansion are charged with attempting to provide material support to ISIS and using a weapon of mass destruction.

item.title: Pennsylvania schools will be required to teach cursive again starting in April
item.description: Starting April 12, all public and private schools in Pennsylvania must reintroduce cursive handwriting into their curriculum.

item.title: Philadelphia Eagles reportedly set to part ways with key players
item.description: Several key Philadelphia Eagles, including Jaelan Phillips, Nakobe Dean, Reed Blankenship, and Jahan Dotson, are reportedly expected to depart next season.
